text:
maria: Heads-up — I merged the telemetry PR for request/response logging to staging. We should decide sampling + PII rules before we enable it for prod.
ajay: Link? want to scan the config.
mar
: https://github.com/redwood-inc/telemetry/pull/482 — main bits: default sampling 5% for user requests, full capture for error responses, and a redaction pipeline that strips obvious PII.
telemetry-bot: CI checks passed (unit tests + fmt).
samir: 5% seems fine for metrics, but payloads are tricky. Are we redacting free-text content or just structured fields?
katie: Legal: we can only keep user identifiers if hashed with per-tenant salt and retention <90 days. Also need opt-out for customers in private deployments.
ajay: We currently have a step that replaces these keys: email, phone, ssn, credit_card using regex -> "[REDACTED]". But free-text may leak.
maria: We debated using an NLP PII detector, but perf is a concern in the hot path. The PR added async enrichment + a small sync regex layer.
samir: Can we include a sampled raw payload but with user_id hashed and prefix preserved? e.g., keep first 8 chars of prompt length and hash rest. That preserves some debugging signal without PII.
katie: Prefers tokenization to irreversible pseudonymization. Hash+salt + rotate key policy required.
ajay: Operational question: how do we expose this in Console? Toggle per-tenant: OFF (no logs), LOW (5% sampling), HIGH (20%), DEBUG (full capture but masked). Need explicit opt-in for DEBUG.
maria: UX note: default for hosted customers should be LOW. Dedicated/Private get explicit admin control and a compliance checkbox.
telemetry-bot: Example log after redaction:
```
{
  "req_id": "r_abc123",
  "user_id_hash": "sha256:abcd...",
  "prompt": "[REDACTED]",
  "response": "Model output truncated",
  "sampling_reason": "random:0.045",
  "env": "staging"
}
```
ajay: That looks fine. But the prompt "[REDACTED]" kills debugging. Can we store a fingerprint instead (n-gram hash) so we can group similar failures?
samir: Yes, store a context_fingerprint field: an HMAC of the first 512 chars then drop raw text. Fingerprints are useful for QA and regression alerts.
katie: Make sure we log whether redaction was applied so audits can show how many captures were redacted. Also track which redaction rule matched.
maria: Agree. Let's add metadata fields: redaction_applied: boolean, redaction_rules: [list].
ajay: Perf note: computing HMAC/hash is cheap, NLP PII detectors are expensive. For now keep ML detector as a background job that can flag missed PII and trigger deletion.
telemetry-bot: Proposal for policy doc snippet in Console:
```
Retention: 90 days
Sampling default: 5% (hosted)
PII handling: sync regex + hashed IDs; async ML scan for unstructured text
Debug capture: admin opt-in; logs stored in encrypted bucket
```
katie: Need to add legal retention exception process and DSAR handling steps.
samir: Also need an incident workflow if a disabled retention policy accidentally stores raw text. Audit logs + automated purge.
maria: Implementation tasks: 1) add per-tenant sampling toggle in registry API 2) store redaction metadata with each capture 3) implement fingerprint/hmac 4) Console toggles + audit checkbox.
ajay: I'll update the PR to include a sample schema and the Console API surface.
maria: Cool. Can we schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize wording? 10:30am works for me.
katie: I'm in. Please include Legal in invite.
samir: +1. Also add a test plan: sampling determinism test, redaction rule coverage, ML-scan false negative analysis.
deploy-bot: prod toggle will remain off until "redaction-policy" feature flag is approved by infra and privacy.
maria: Thanks all — leaving action items in the PR. :thumbsup:
